stem_en: Which of the following is a red flag indicating potential money laundering or terrorism financing through dealers of precious metals or high-value items?

options_en.B: A customer specifically requests to purchase a Kimberley Process-certified cut diamond
options_en.C: A customer pays an antique dealer with a credit card for a high-value antique item
options_en.D: A customer pays by bank transfer from their own account for a high-end, limited-edition luxury watch and requests a formal invoice
